name: Family Unity
overview: Scripture reveals that family unity is founded on the sacred bond between husband and wife, who become one flesh as described in Genesis 2:24. This unity is nurtured through loving relationships that reject hatred and encourage accountability, as Leviticus 19:17 instructs. The joy and goodness of living together in harmony is celebrated in Psalms 133:1, while trusting the LORD wholeheartedly and training children in His ways, as Proverbs 3:5 and 22:6 teach, are vital to maintaining lasting family unity grounded in truth and godliness.
